bias_targets.methodology: Conversational red-teaming using multi-turn adversarial prompts to elicit racial slurs or agreement with hate speech against specific racial groups, evaluated by an LLM-as-a-judge using a 1-5 harmfulness scale.
Using automated adversarial attacks to prompt target models into endorsing derogatory or xenophobic statements about specific nationalities, scored for harmfulness by a judge LLM.
Adversarially prompting target models to provide advice or endorse discriminatory and violent actions against homeless populations, with outputs evaluated by an LLM judge based on safety guidelines.
